  Widget _captureButton(
    AtlasGuidedInspectionStep step, {
    TextEditingController? textTarget,
  }) {
    final bool captured = _hasImage(step);
    return OutlinedButton.icon(
      onPressed: _busy
          ? null
          : () => _captureStep(step, textTarget: textTarget),
      icon: Icon(
        captured ? Icons.check_circle_outline : Icons.add_a_photo_outlined,
      ),
      label: Text(
        captured ? 'Captured — Replace Image' : 'Capture or Choose Image',
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _check(String label, bool? value, ValueChanged<bool?> update) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: AtlasSpacing.sm),
      child: DropdownButtonFormField<bool?>(
        initialValue: value,
        decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: label),
        items: const [
          DropdownMenuItem<bool?>(value: null, child: Text('Not inspected')),
          DropdownMenuItem<bool?>(value: true, child: Text('Yes')),
          DropdownMenuItem<bool?>(
            value: false,
            child: Text('No / warning seen'),
          ),
        ],
        onChanged: (bool? next) => setState(() {
          update(next);
          _preview = null;
        }),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _evidenceStrip(List<ScanImage> images) {
    return AtlasGlassCard(
      accentColor: AtlasColors.intelligenceBlue,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          const AtlasSectionHeader(
            title: '📸 Captured Evidence',
            subtitle: 'Local previews for the current inspection session.',
            icon: Icons.photo_library_outlined,
            accentColor: AtlasColors.intelligenceBlue,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.md),
          SizedBox(
            height: 104,
            child: ListView.separated(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              itemCount: images.length,
              separatorBuilder: (_, _) =>
                  const SizedBox(width: AtlasSpacing.sm),
              itemBuilder: (_, int index) => ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                child: Image.file(
                  File(images[index].localPath!),
                  width: 92,
                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String _shortStepTitle(AtlasGuidedInspectionStep step) {
    return switch (step) {
      AtlasGuidedInspectionStep.frontBox => 'Front',
      AtlasGuidedInspectionStep.stickerWindow => 'Sticker',
      AtlasGuidedInspectionStep.bottomStamp => 'Stamp',
      AtlasGuidedInspectionStep.packagingCopyright => 'Packaging',
      AtlasGuidedInspectionStep.autograph => 'Autograph',
      AtlasGuidedInspectionStep.coa => 'COA',
    };
  }
}

class _InspectionStepState {
  const _InspectionStepState(this.label, this.icon, this.color);

  final String label;
  final IconData icon;
  final Color color;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class AddPopScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AddPopScreen({
    super.key,
    this.atlasProduct,
    this.collectionName,
    this.visualInspection,
  });

  final AtlasCatalogProduct? atlasProduct;
  final String? collectionName;
  final AtlasVisualInspection? visualInspection;

  @override
  State<AddPopScreen> createState() => _AddPopScreenState();
}

class _AddPopScreenState extends State<AddPopScreen> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();

  final _nameController = TextEditingController();
  final _numberController = TextEditingController();
  final _categoryController = TextEditingController();
  final _seriesController = TextEditingController();
  final _valueController = TextEditingController();
  final _pricePaidController = TextEditingController();
  final _quantityController = TextEditingController(text: '1');
  final _itemConditionController = TextEditingController();
  final _boxConditionController = TextEditingController();
  final _imageUrlController = TextEditingController();
  final _customVariantController = TextEditingController();
  final _customRetailExclusiveController = TextEditingController();
  final _customEventStickerController = TextEditingController();
  final _customLimitedEditionController = TextEditingController();
  final _customSignatureController = TextEditingController();
  final _productionCodeController = TextEditingController();
  final _copyrightYearController = TextEditingController();
  final _stickerTypeController = TextEditingController();
  final _authenticationProviderController = TextEditingController();
  final _authenticityNumberController = TextEditingController();

  String _variant = 'Common';
  String _retailExclusive = 'None';
  String _eventSticker = 'None';
  String _limitedEdition = 'None';
  String _signature = 'Unsigned';

  bool get _hasCatalogProduct {
    return widget.atlasProduct != null;
  }

  String _formatCategory(String value) {
    if (value.isEmpty) {
      return '';
    }

    const upperCategories = {
      'dc': 'DC',
      'wwe': 'WWE',
      'nba': 'NBA',
      'nfl': 'NFL',
      'mlb': 'MLB',
      'ufc': 'UFC',
    };

    final lower = value.toLowerCase();

    if (upperCategories.containsKey(lower)) {
      return upperCategories[lower]!;
    }

    return value
        .split(' ')
        .map(
          (word) => word.isEmpty
              ? word
              : word[0].toUpperCase() + word.substring(1).toLowerCase(),
        )
        .join(' ');
  }

  String _catalogIdentitySelection({
    required String value,
    required List<String> options,
    required String fallback,
    required TextEditingController customController,
  }) {
    final String normalized = value.trim();

    if (normalized.isEmpty) {
      return fallback;
    }

    if (options.contains(normalized)) {
      return normalized;
    }

    customController.text = normalized;

    return 'Other';
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    final AtlasCatalogProduct? product = widget.atlasProduct;

    final inspection = widget.visualInspection;
    if (inspection != null) {
      _productionCodeController.text = inspection.productionStampText;
      _copyrightYearController.text = inspection.copyrightText;
      _stickerTypeController.text = inspection.stickerText;
      _authenticationProviderController.text =
          inspection.authenticationProvider;
      _authenticityNumberController.text = inspection.authenticityNumber;
      if (inspection.signature.trim().isNotEmpty) {
        _customSignatureController.text = inspection.signature.trim();
        _signature = 'Other';
      }
    }

    if (product == null) {
      return;
    }

    final catalogPop = AtlasPopFactory.createFromCatalog(product: product);

    _nameController.text = catalogPop.name;
    _numberController.text = catalogPop.number;
    _categoryController.text = _formatCategory(catalogPop.category);
    _seriesController.text = catalogPop.series;
    _itemConditionController.text = catalogPop.itemCondition;
    _boxConditionController.text = catalogPop.boxCondition;
    _imageUrlController.text = catalogPop.imageUrl;

    if (catalogPop.value > 0) {
      _valueController.text = catalogPop.value.toStringAsFixed(2);
    }

    _variant = _catalogIdentitySelection(
      value: catalogPop.variant,
      options: CollectorIdentityOptions.variants,
      fallback: 'Common',
      customController: _customVariantController,
    );
    _retailExclusive = _catalogIdentitySelection(
      value: catalogPop.retailExclusive,
      options: CollectorIdentityOptions.retailExclusives,
      fallback: 'None',
      customController: _customRetailExclusiveController,
    );
    _eventSticker = _catalogIdentitySelection(
      value: catalogPop.eventSticker,
      options: CollectorIdentityOptions.eventStickers,
      fallback: 'None',
      customController: _customEventStickerController,
    );
    _limitedEdition = _catalogIdentitySelection(
      value: catalogPop.limitedEdition,
      options: CollectorIdentityOptions.limitedEditions,
      fallback: 'None',
      customController: _customLimitedEditionController,
    );
    _signature = _catalogIdentitySelection(
      value: catalogPop.signature,
      options: CollectorIdentityOptions.signatures,
      fallback: 'Unsigned',
      customController: _customSignatureController,
    );

    if (inspection != null && inspection.signature.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      _customSignatureController.text = inspection.signature.trim();
      _signature = 'Other';
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _numberController.dispose();
    _categoryController.dispose();
    _seriesController.dispose();
    _valueController.dispose();
    _pricePaidController.dispose();
    _quantityController.dispose();
    _itemConditionController.dispose();
    _boxConditionController.dispose();
    _imageUrlController.dispose();
    _customVariantController.dispose();
    _customRetailExclusiveController.dispose();
    _customEventStickerController.dispose();
    _customLimitedEditionController.dispose();
    _customSignatureController.dispose();
    _productionCodeController.dispose();
    _copyrightYearController.dispose();
    _stickerTypeController.dispose();
    _authenticationProviderController.dispose();
    _authenticityNumberController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String _resolvedIdentityValue({
    required String selectedValue,
    required TextEditingController customController,
    required String fallback,
  }) {
    if (selectedValue != 'Other') {
      return selectedValue;
    }

    final customValue = customController.text.trim();

    return customValue.isEmpty ? fallback : customValue;
  }

  Future<void> _savePop() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      return;
    }

    final resolvedVariant = _resolvedIdentityValue(
      selectedValue: _variant,
      customController: _customVariantController,
      fallback: 'Common',
    );

    final resolvedRetailExclusive = _resolvedIdentityValue(
      selectedValue: _retailExclusive,
      customController: _customRetailExclusiveController,
      fallback: 'None',
    );

    final resolvedEventSticker = _resolvedIdentityValue(
      selectedValue: _eventSticker,
      customController: _customEventStickerController,
      fallback: 'None',
    );

    final resolvedLimitedEdition = _resolvedIdentityValue(
      selectedValue: _limitedEdition,
      customController: _customLimitedEditionController,
      fallback: 'None',
    );

    final selectedSignature = _resolvedIdentityValue(
      selectedValue: _signature,
      customController: _customSignatureController,
      fallback: 'Unsigned',
    );
    final resolvedSignature = _customSignatureController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? _customSignatureController.text.trim()
        : selectedSignature;

    final double value = PopFormValues.parseOptionalMoney(
      _valueController.text,
    );

    final double pricePaid = PopFormValues.parseOptionalMoney(
      _pricePaidController.text,
    );

    final int quantity = PopFormValues.parseQuantity(_quantityController.text);

    final AtlasCatalogProduct? product = widget.atlasProduct;

    final pop = product == null
        ? AtlasPopFactory.createManual(
            name: _nameController.text,
            number: _numberController.text,
            category: _formatCategory(_categoryController.text.trim()),
            series: _seriesController.text,
            variant: resolvedVariant,
            retailExclusive: resolvedRetailExclusive,
            eventSticker: resolvedEventSticker,
            limitedEdition: resolvedLimitedEdition,
            signature: resolvedSignature,
            productionCode: _productionCodeController.text,
            copyrightYear: _copyrightYearController.text,
            stickerType: _stickerTypeController.text,
            authenticationProvider: _authenticationProviderController.text,
            authenticityNumber: _authenticityNumberController.text,
            value: value,
            pricePaid: pricePaid,
            quantity: quantity,
            itemCondition: _itemConditionController.text,
            boxCondition: _boxConditionController.text,
            imageUrl: _imageUrlController.text,
            owner: 'Shared',
            isWishlist: false,
          )
        : AtlasPopFactory.createFromCatalog(
            product: product,
            name: _nameController.text,
            number: _numberController.text,
            category: _formatCategory(_categoryController.text.trim()),
            series: _seriesController.text,
            variant: resolvedVariant,
            retailExclusive: resolvedRetailExclusive,
            eventSticker: resolvedEventSticker,
            limitedEdition: resolvedLimitedEdition,
            signature: resolvedSignature,
            productionCode: _productionCodeController.text,
            copyrightYear: _copyrightYearController.text,
            stickerType: _stickerTypeController.text,
            authenticationProvider: _authenticationProviderController.text,
            authenticityNumber: _authenticityNumberController.text,
            value: value,
            pricePaid: pricePaid,
            quantity: quantity,
            itemCondition: _itemConditionController.text,
            boxCondition: _boxConditionController.text,
            imageUrl: _imageUrlController.text,
            owner: 'Shared',
            isWishlist: false,
          );

    final added = await context.read<AppState>().addPop(
      pop,
      collectionName: widget.collectionName,
    );

    if (!added) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              'This collection could not be found. The Pop was not added.',
            ),
          ),
        );
      }

      return;
    }

    AtlasActivityService.record(
      title: 'Pop Added',
      description: '${pop.name} #${pop.number} was added to the Vault.',
      type: 'pop_added',
    );

    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }

    Navigator.pop(context, true);
  }

                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.lg),
            AtlasGlassCard(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  const AtlasSectionHeader(
                    title: 'Condition & Image',
                    subtitle: 'Record the collectible, box, and display image.',
                    icon: Icons.photo_camera_back_outlined,
                    accentColor: AtlasColors.vaultGold,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.md),
                  AtlasFormField(
                    controller: _itemConditionController,
                    label: 'Item Condition',
                    icon: Icons.auto_awesome_outlined,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.md),
                  AtlasFormField(
                    controller: _boxConditionController,
                    label: 'Box Condition',
                    icon: Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.md),
                  AtlasFormField(
                    controller: _imageUrlController,
                    label: 'Image URL',
                    icon: Icons.link_rounded,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.url,
                    onChanged: (_) {
                      setState(() {});
                    },
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.xl),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: _savePop,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.save_rounded),
                label: const Text('Save Pop'),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

enum EditPopInitialSection { none, collectorIdentity, condition, value }

class EditPopScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const EditPopScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.pop,
    this.collectionName,
    this.initialSection = EditPopInitialSection.none,
    this.focusValueField = false,
  });

  final Pop pop;
  final String? collectionName;

  /// Opens Edit Pop at a specific section.
  final EditPopInitialSection initialSection;

  /// Preserved for existing callers that specifically want the
  /// Estimated Value field selected and focused.
  final bool focusValueField;

  @override
  State<EditPopScreen> createState() => _EditPopScreenState();
}

class _EditPopScreenState extends State<EditPopScreen> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final ScrollController _scrollController = ScrollController();

  final GlobalKey _collectorIdentitySectionKey = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _conditionSectionKey = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _valueSectionKey = GlobalKey();

  final FocusNode _itemConditionFocusNode = FocusNode();
  final FocusNode _valueFocusNode = FocusNode();

  late TextEditingController _nameController;
  late TextEditingController _numberController;
  late TextEditingController _categoryController;
  late TextEditingController _seriesController;
  late TextEditingController _valueController;
  late TextEditingController _pricePaidController;
  late TextEditingController _quantityController;
  late TextEditingController _itemConditionController;
  late TextEditingController _boxConditionController;
  late TextEditingController _imageUrlController;
  late TextEditingController _customVariantController;
  late TextEditingController _customRetailExclusiveController;
  late TextEditingController _customEventStickerController;
  late TextEditingController _customLimitedEditionController;
  late TextEditingController _customSignatureController;
  late TextEditingController _productionCodeController;
  late TextEditingController _copyrightYearController;
  late TextEditingController _stickerTypeController;
  late TextEditingController _authenticationProviderController;
  late TextEditingController _authenticityNumberController;

  late String _owner;
  late String _variant;
  late String _retailExclusive;
  late String _eventSticker;
  late String _limitedEdition;
  late String _signature;

  static const List<String> _defaultOwnerOptions = [
    'Arthur',
    'Natacia',
    'Amerika',
    'Nyssa',
    'Angelica',
    'Shared',
  ];

  late List<String> _ownerOptions;

  String _safeOption(String value, List<String> options, String fallback) {
    return options.contains(value) ? value : fallback;
  }

  bool _isCustomValue(String value, List<String> options) {
    final cleaned = value.trim();

    return cleaned.isNotEmpty && !options.contains(cleaned);
  }

  String _resolvedIdentityValue({
    required String selectedValue,
    required TextEditingController customController,
    required String fallback,
  }) {
    if (selectedValue != 'Other') {
      return selectedValue;
    }

    final customValue = customController.text.trim();

    return customValue.isEmpty ? fallback : customValue;
  }

  String _formatCategory(String value) {
    if (value.isEmpty) {
      return '';
    }

    const upperCategories = {
      'dc': 'DC',
      'wwe': 'WWE',
      'nba': 'NBA',
      'nfl': 'NFL',
      'mlb': 'MLB',
      'ufc': 'UFC',
    };

    final lower = value.toLowerCase();

    if (upperCategories.containsKey(lower)) {
      return upperCategories[lower]!;
    }

    return value
        .split(' ')
        .map(
          (word) => word.isEmpty
              ? word
              : word[0].toUpperCase() + word.substring(1).toLowerCase(),
        )
        .join(' ');
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    _nameController = TextEditingController(text: widget.pop.name);
    _numberController = TextEditingController(text: widget.pop.number);
    _categoryController = TextEditingController(text: widget.pop.category);
    _seriesController = TextEditingController(text: widget.pop.series);
    _valueController = TextEditingController(text: widget.pop.value.toString());
    _pricePaidController = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.pop.pricePaid.toString(),
    );
    _quantityController = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.pop.quantity.toString(),
    );
    _itemConditionController = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.pop.itemCondition,
    );
    _boxConditionController = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.pop.boxCondition,
    );
    _imageUrlController = TextEditingController(text: widget.pop.imageUrl);
    _productionCodeController = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.pop.productionCode,
    );
    _copyrightYearController = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.pop.copyrightYear,
    );
    _stickerTypeController = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.pop.stickerType,
    );
    _authenticationProviderController = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.pop.authenticationProvider,
    );
    _authenticityNumberController = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.pop.authenticityNumber,
    );

    _owner = widget.pop.owner.trim().isEmpty
        ? 'Shared'
        : widget.pop.owner.trim();
    _ownerOptions = <String>[
      ..._defaultOwnerOptions,
      if (!_defaultOwnerOptions.contains(_owner)) _owner,
    ];

    final savedVariant = widget.pop.variant.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? widget.pop.variant.trim()
        : widget.pop.edition.trim();

    _customVariantController = TextEditingController(
      text: _isCustomValue(savedVariant, CollectorIdentityOptions.variants)
          ? savedVariant
          : '',
    );

    _variant = _isCustomValue(savedVariant, CollectorIdentityOptions.variants)
        ? 'Other'
        : _safeOption(
            savedVariant,
            CollectorIdentityOptions.variants,
            'Common',
          );

    _customRetailExclusiveController = TextEditingController(
      text:
          _isCustomValue(
            widget.pop.retailExclusive,
            CollectorIdentityOptions.retailExclusives,
          )
          ? widget.pop.retailExclusive
          : '',
    );

    _retailExclusive =
        _isCustomValue(
          widget.pop.retailExclusive,
          CollectorIdentityOptions.retailExclusives,
        )
        ? 'Other'
        : _safeOption(
            widget.pop.retailExclusive,
            CollectorIdentityOptions.retailExclusives,
            'None',
          );

    _customEventStickerController = TextEditingController(
      text:
          _isCustomValue(
            widget.pop.eventSticker,
            CollectorIdentityOptions.eventStickers,
          )
          ? widget.pop.eventSticker
          : '',
    );

    _eventSticker =
        _isCustomValue(
          widget.pop.eventSticker,
          CollectorIdentityOptions.eventStickers,
        )
        ? 'Other'
        : _safeOption(
            widget.pop.eventSticker,
            CollectorIdentityOptions.eventStickers,
            'None',
          );

    _customLimitedEditionController = TextEditingController(
      text:
          _isCustomValue(
            widget.pop.limitedEdition,
            CollectorIdentityOptions.limitedEditions,
          )
          ? widget.pop.limitedEdition
          : '',
    );

    _limitedEdition =
        _isCustomValue(
          widget.pop.limitedEdition,
          CollectorIdentityOptions.limitedEditions,
        )
        ? 'Other'
        : _safeOption(
            widget.pop.limitedEdition,
            CollectorIdentityOptions.limitedEditions,
            'None',
          );

    _customSignatureController = TextEditingController(
      text:
          _isCustomValue(
            widget.pop.signature,
            CollectorIdentityOptions.signatures,
          )
          ? widget.pop.signature
          : '',
    );

    _signature =
        _isCustomValue(
          widget.pop.signature,
          CollectorIdentityOptions.signatures,
        )
        ? 'Other'
        : _safeOption(
            widget.pop.signature,
            CollectorIdentityOptions.signatures,
            'Unsigned',
          );

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (widget.focusValueField) {
        _focusValueSection();
        return;
      }

      _focusInitialSection();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _focusInitialSection() async {
    switch (widget.initialSection) {
      case EditPopInitialSection.none:
        return;

      case EditPopInitialSection.collectorIdentity:
        await _scrollToSection(_collectorIdentitySectionKey);
        return;

      case EditPopInitialSection.condition:
        await _scrollToSection(_conditionSectionKey);

        if (!mounted) {
          return;
        }

        _itemConditionFocusNode.requestFocus();
        return;

      case EditPopInitialSection.value:
        await _focusValueSection();
        return;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _scrollToSection(
    GlobalKey sectionKey, {
    double alignment = 0.12,
  }) async {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }

    final BuildContext? sectionContext = sectionKey.currentContext;

    if (sectionContext == null) {
      return;
    }

    await Scrollable.ensureVisible(
      sectionContext,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 450),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      alignment: alignment,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _focusValueSection() async {
    await _scrollToSection(_valueSectionKey, alignment: 0.15);

    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }

    _valueFocusNode.requestFocus();

    _valueController.selection = TextSelection(
      baseOffset: 0,
      extentOffset: _valueController.text.length,
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _numberController.dispose();
    _categoryController.dispose();
    _seriesController.dispose();
    _valueController.dispose();
    _pricePaidController.dispose();
    _quantityController.dispose();
    _itemConditionController.dispose();
    _boxConditionController.dispose();
    _imageUrlController.dispose();
    _scrollController.dispose();
    _itemConditionFocusNode.dispose();
    _valueFocusNode.dispose();
    _customVariantController.dispose();
    _customRetailExclusiveController.dispose();
    _customEventStickerController.dispose();
    _customLimitedEditionController.dispose();
    _customSignatureController.dispose();
    _productionCodeController.dispose();
    _copyrightYearController.dispose();
    _stickerTypeController.dispose();
    _authenticationProviderController.dispose();
    _authenticityNumberController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _saveChanges() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      return;
    }

    final resolvedVariant = _resolvedIdentityValue(
      selectedValue: _variant,
      customController: _customVariantController,
      fallback: 'Common',
    );

    final resolvedRetailExclusive = _resolvedIdentityValue(
      selectedValue: _retailExclusive,
      customController: _customRetailExclusiveController,
      fallback: 'None',
    );

    final resolvedEventSticker = _resolvedIdentityValue(
      selectedValue: _eventSticker,
      customController: _customEventStickerController,
      fallback: 'None',
    );

    final resolvedLimitedEdition = _resolvedIdentityValue(
      selectedValue: _limitedEdition,
      customController: _customLimitedEditionController,
      fallback: 'None',
    );

    final selectedSignature = _resolvedIdentityValue(
      selectedValue: _signature,
      customController: _customSignatureController,
      fallback: 'Unsigned',
    );
    final resolvedSignature = _customSignatureController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? _customSignatureController.text.trim()
        : selectedSignature;

    final updatedPop = widget.pop.copyWith(
      name: _nameController.text.trim(),
      number: _numberController.text.trim(),
      category: _formatCategory(_categoryController.text.trim()),
      series: _seriesController.text.trim(),
      variant: resolvedVariant,
      retailExclusive: resolvedRetailExclusive,
      eventSticker: resolvedEventSticker,
      limitedEdition: resolvedLimitedEdition,
      signature: resolvedSignature,
      productionCode: _productionCodeController.text.trim(),
      copyrightYear: _copyrightYearController.text.trim(),
      stickerType: _stickerTypeController.text.trim(),
      authenticationProvider: _authenticationProviderController.text.trim(),
      authenticityNumber: _authenticityNumberController.text.trim(),
      value: PopFormValues.parseOptionalMoney(_valueController.text),
      pricePaid: PopFormValues.parseOptionalMoney(_pricePaidController.text),
      quantity: PopFormValues.parseQuantity(_quantityController.text),
      itemCondition: _itemConditionController.text.trim(),
      boxCondition: _boxConditionController.text.trim(),
      imageUrl: _imageUrlController.text.trim(),
      owner: _owner,
    );

    final appState = context.read<AppState>();
    final valueChanged = updatedPop.value != widget.pop.value;

    final persistedPop = await appState.updatePop(
      updatedPop,
      collectionName: widget.collectionName,
      existingRecordKey: widget.pop.collectionRecordKey,
    );

    if (persistedPop == null) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              'This Pop could not be found. No changes were saved.',
            ),
          ),
        );
      }

      return;
    }

    await appState.addActivity(
      Activity(
        id: DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
        popId: persistedPop.id,
        action: valueChanged ? 'value_updated' : 'pop_updated',
        popName: persistedPop.name,
        popNumber: persistedPop.number,
        owner: persistedPop.owner,
        actor: persistedPop.owner,
        details: valueChanged
            ? _valueUpdateDetails(
                pop: persistedPop,
                previousValue: widget.pop.value,
              )
            : persistedPop.number.trim().isEmpty
            ? '${persistedPop.name} was updated'
            : '${persistedPop.name} #${persistedPop.number} was updated',
        timestamp: DateTime.now(),
      ),
    );

    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }

    Navigator.pop(context, persistedPop);
  }

  String _valueUpdateDetails({
    required Pop pop,
    required double previousValue,
  }) {
    final previousLabel = previousValue <= 0
        ? 'not entered'
        : '\$${previousValue.toStringAsFixed(2)}';

    final updatedLabel = pop.value <= 0
        ? 'not entered'
        : '\$${pop.value.toStringAsFixed(2)}';

    return '${pop.name} value changed from $previousLabel to $updatedLabel';
  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'package:funkovault2/atlas/collection/actions/atlas_collector_action.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/theme/atlas_colors.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/theme/atlas_spacing.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/widgets/atlas/atlas_glass_card.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/widgets/atlas/components/atlas_action_row.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/widgets/atlas/components/atlas_section_header.dart';
import 'package:funkovault2/widgets/atlas/components/atlas_status_chip.dart';

class AtlasCollectorActionBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const AtlasCollectorActionBar({
    required this.actions,
    required this.onActionPressed,
    super.key,
  });

  final List<AtlasCollectorAction> actions;
  final ValueChanged<AtlasCollectorActionType> onActionPressed;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (actions.isEmpty) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    final List<AtlasCollectorAction> sortedActions =
    List<AtlasCollectorAction>.from(actions)
      ..sort(
            (
            AtlasCollectorAction first,
            AtlasCollectorAction second,
            ) {
          return first.priority.compareTo(second.priority);
        },
      );

    final AtlasCollectorAction? primaryAction = _findPrimaryAction(
      sortedActions,
    );

    return AtlasGlassCard(
      accentColor: AtlasColors.intelligenceBlue,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AtlasSpacing.lg),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          AtlasSectionHeader(
            title: 'Quick Actions',
            subtitle:
            'Recommended actions based on this collectible and your collection.',
            icon: Icons.bolt_rounded,
            accentColor: AtlasColors.intelligenceBlue,
            badge: primaryAction == null
                ? null
                : const AtlasStatusChip(
              label: 'Atlas Ready',
              icon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
              accentColor: AtlasColors.vaultGold,
              size: AtlasStatusChipSize.compact,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.lg),
          for (int index = 0; index < sortedActions.length; index++) ...[
            _CollectorActionRow(
              action: sortedActions[index],
              onPressed: () {
                onActionPressed(sortedActions[index].type);
              },
            ),
            if (index < sortedActions.length - 1)
              const SizedBox(height: AtlasSpacing.sm),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  AtlasCollectorAction? _findPrimaryAction(
      List<AtlasCollectorAction> actions,
      ) {
    for (final AtlasCollectorAction action in actions) {
      if (action.isPrimary) {
        return action;
      }
    }

    return null;
  }
}

class _CollectorActionRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CollectorActionRow({
    required this.action,
    required this.onPressed,
  });

  final AtlasCollectorAction action;
  final VoidCallback onPressed;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final _ActionPresentation presentation = _presentationFor(action.type);

    return AtlasActionRow(
      title: action.label,
      description: presentation.description,
      icon: action.icon,
      accentColor: presentation.accentColor,
      badge: action.isPrimary
          ? const AtlasStatusChip(
        label: 'Recommended',
        icon: Icons.star_rounded,
        accentColor: AtlasColors.vaultGold,
        size: AtlasStatusChipSize.compact,
      )
          : null,
      compact: action.type == AtlasCollectorActionType.scanAnother,
      showChevron: action.type != AtlasCollectorActionType.scanAnother,
      onTap: onPressed,
    );
  }

  _ActionPresentation _presentationFor(
      AtlasCollectorActionType type,
      ) {
    switch (type) {
      case AtlasCollectorActionType.viewExistingItem:
        return const _ActionPresentation(
          description:
          'Open the collectible already stored in this collection.',
          accentColor: AtlasColors.success,
        );

      case AtlasCollectorActionType.addToVault:
        return const _ActionPresentation(
          description:
          'Add this collectible to the selected collection.',
          accentColor: AtlasColors.vaultGold,
        );

      case AtlasCollectorActionType.addAnotherCopy:
        return const _ActionPresentation(
          description:
          'Add another physical copy while preserving the existing collectible.',
          accentColor: AtlasColors.vaultGold,
        );

      case AtlasCollectorActionType.reviewVariantSticker:
        return const _ActionPresentation(
          description:
          'Review variant, exclusive, sticker, limited edition, and signature details.',
          accentColor: AtlasColors.intelligenceBlue,
        );

      case AtlasCollectorActionType.updateCondition:
        return const _ActionPresentation(
          description:
          'Update the collectible and box condition for your existing copy.',
          accentColor: AtlasColors.intelligenceBlue,
        );

      case AtlasCollectorActionType.addToWishlist:
        return const _ActionPresentation(
          description:
          'Track this collectible on your wishlist for later.',
          accentColor: AtlasColors.intelligenceBlue,
        );

      case AtlasCollectorActionType.removeFromWishlist:
        return const _ActionPresentation(
          description:
          'Remove this collectible from the wishlist for this collection.',
          accentColor: AtlasColors.warning,
        );

      case AtlasCollectorActionType.scanAnother:
        return const _ActionPresentation(
          description:
          'Return to the scanner and identify another collectible.',
          accentColor: AtlasColors.textSecondary,
        );
    }
  }
}

class _ActionPresentation {
  const _ActionPresentation({
    required this.description,
    required this.accentColor,
  });

  final String description;
  final Color accentColor;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum AtlasCollectorActionType {
  viewExistingItem,
  addToVault,
  addAnotherCopy,
  reviewVariantSticker,
  updateCondition,
  addToWishlist,
  removeFromWishlist,
  scanAnother,
}

@immutable
class AtlasCollectorAction {
  const AtlasCollectorAction({
    required this.type,
    required this.label,
    required this.icon,
    required this.priority,
    this.isPrimary = false,
  });

  final AtlasCollectorActionType type;
  final String label;
  final IconData icon;
  final int priority;
  final bool isPrimary;

  AtlasCollectorAction copyWith({
    AtlasCollectorActionType? type,
    String? label,
    IconData? icon,
    int? priority,
    bool? isPrimary,
  }) {
    return AtlasCollectorAction(
      type: type ?? this.type,
      label: label ?? this.label,
      icon: icon ?? this.icon,
      priority: priority ?? this.priority,
      isPrimary: isPrimary ?? this.isPrimary,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) {
    return identical(this, other) ||
        other is AtlasCollectorAction &&
            runtimeType == other.runtimeType &&
            type == other.type &&
            label == other.label &&
            icon == other.icon &&
            priority == other.priority &&
            isPrimary == other.isPrimary;
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode {
    return Object.hash(
      type,
      label,
      icon,
      priority,
      isPrimary,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'atlas_collector_action.dart';

class AtlasCollectorActionContext {
  const AtlasCollectorActionContext({
    required this.isOwned,
    required this.isWishlisted,
    required this.canViewExistingItem,
    this.includeScanAnother = true,
  });

  final bool isOwned;
  final bool isWishlisted;
  final bool canViewExistingItem;
  final bool includeScanAnother;
}

class AtlasCollectorActionEngine {
  const AtlasCollectorActionEngine();

  List<AtlasCollectorAction> buildActions(
      AtlasCollectorActionContext context,
      ) {
    final List<AtlasCollectorAction> actions = <AtlasCollectorAction>[];

    if (context.isOwned && context.canViewExistingItem) {
      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.viewExistingItem,
          label: 'View Existing Item',
          icon: Icons.visibility_outlined,
          priority: 10,
          isPrimary: true,
        ),
      );

      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.addAnotherCopy,
          label: 'Add Another Copy',
          icon: Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded,
          priority: 20,
        ),
      );

      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.reviewVariantSticker,
          label: 'Review Variant / Sticker',
          icon: Icons.verified_outlined,
          priority: 30,
        ),
      );

      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.updateCondition,
          label: 'Update Condition',
          icon: Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
          priority: 40,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.addToVault,
          label: 'Add to Vault',
          icon: Icons.add_circle_rounded,
          priority: 10,
          isPrimary: true,
        ),
      );
    }

    if (context.isWishlisted) {
      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.removeFromWishlist,
          label: 'Remove from Wishlist',
          icon: Icons.heart_broken_rounded,
          priority: 50,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.addToWishlist,
          label: 'Add to Wishlist',
          icon: Icons.favorite_border_rounded,
          priority: 50,
        ),
      );
    }

    if (context.includeScanAnother) {
      actions.add(
        const AtlasCollectorAction(
          type: AtlasCollectorActionType.scanAnother,
          label: 'Scan Another',
          icon: Icons.qr_code_scanner_rounded,
          priority: 100,
        ),
      );
    }

    actions.sort(
          (
          AtlasCollectorAction first,
          AtlasCollectorAction second,
          ) {
        return first.priority.compareTo(second.priority);
      },
    );

    return List<AtlasCollectorAction>.unmodifiable(actions);
  }
}

import '../../../models/pop.dart';
import '../../scan/tracking/atlas_scan_observation.dart';

enum AtlasShelfObservationState {
  owned,
  notInVault,
  possibleVariant,
  extraCopy,
  needsReview,
}

/// Persistent shelf-session representation of one observed physical object.
///
/// A shelf observation may outlive any individual Scanner 6A track. Track IDs
/// remain transient acquisition identifiers; [observationId] is the persistent
/// identity used only inside the shelf scan session.
final class AtlasShelfObservation {
  AtlasShelfObservation({
    required this.observationId,
    required this.firstSeenAt,
    required this.lastSeenAt,
    required Iterable<String> sourceTrackIds,
    this.activeTrackId,
    this.product,
    this.scannedBarcode = '',
    this.confidence = 0,
    this.resolutionRequiresReview = false,
    this.lastKnownBounds,
    this.state = AtlasShelfObservationState.needsReview,
    this.ownedQuantity = 0,
    this.observedCopyIndex = 0,
    this.reidentificationConfidence,
    Iterable<String> notes = const <String>[],
  }) : sourceTrackIds = Set<String>.unmodifiable(sourceTrackIds),
       notes = List<String>.unmodifiable(notes);

  final String observationId;
  final DateTime firstSeenAt;
  final DateTime lastSeenAt;
  final Set<String> sourceTrackIds;
  final String? activeTrackId;

  // Temporary resolved product projection. Never written to the Vault by 6B.
  final Pop? product;
  final String scannedBarcode;
  final double confidence;
  final bool resolutionRequiresReview;
  final AtlasNormalizedBounds? lastKnownBounds;

  final AtlasShelfObservationState state;
  final int ownedQuantity;

  /// One-based observed physical-copy index for the exact release.
  final int observedCopyIndex;

  /// Confidence that a later track was reassociated with this session object.
  /// Null means no cross-track reassociation was performed.
  final double? reidentificationConfidence;

  final List<String> notes;

  bool get isActive =>
      activeTrackId != null && activeTrackId!.trim().isNotEmpty;

  bool get requiresReview =>
      state == AtlasShelfObservationState.needsReview ||
      state == AtlasShelfObservationState.possibleVariant;

  String get collectibleIdentityKey =>
      product?.collectibleIdentityKey.trim() ?? '';

  AtlasShelfObservation copyWith({
    DateTime? lastSeenAt,
    Iterable<String>? sourceTrackIds,
    String? activeTrackId,
    bool clearActiveTrackId = false,
    Pop? product,
    bool clearProduct = false,
    String? scannedBarcode,
    double? confidence,
    bool? resolutionRequiresReview,
    AtlasNormalizedBounds? lastKnownBounds,
    AtlasShelfObservationState? state,
    int? ownedQuantity,
    int? observedCopyIndex,
    double? reidentificationConfidence,
    bool clearReidentificationConfidence = false,
    List<String>? notes,
  }) {
    return AtlasShelfObservation(
      observationId: observationId,
      firstSeenAt: firstSeenAt,
      lastSeenAt: lastSeenAt ?? this.lastSeenAt,
      sourceTrackIds: sourceTrackIds ?? this.sourceTrackIds,
      activeTrackId: clearActiveTrackId
          ? null
          : (activeTrackId ?? this.activeTrackId),
      product: clearProduct ? null : (product ?? this.product),
      scannedBarcode: scannedBarcode ?? this.scannedBarcode,
      confidence: confidence ?? this.confidence,
      resolutionRequiresReview:
          resolutionRequiresReview ?? this.resolutionRequiresReview,
      lastKnownBounds: lastKnownBounds ?? this.lastKnownBounds,
      state: state ?? this.state,
      ownedQuantity: ownedQuantity ?? this.ownedQuantity,
      observedCopyIndex: observedCopyIndex ?? this.observedCopyIndex,
      reidentificationConfidence: clearReidentificationConfidence
          ? null
          : (reidentificationConfidence ?? this.reidentificationConfidence),
      notes: notes ?? this.notes,
    );
  }
}

import '../../../models/pop.dart';

enum AtlasShelfExpectedItemState {
  observed,
  partiallyObserved,
  missingFromShelf,
}

/// Reconciliation of Vault-owned quantity against physical copies observed in
/// the current shelf session.
final class AtlasShelfExpectedItem {
  const AtlasShelfExpectedItem({
    required this.pop,
    required this.expectedQuantity,
    required this.observedQuantity,
    required this.state,
  });

  final Pop pop;
  final int expectedQuantity;
  final int observedQuantity;
  final AtlasShelfExpectedItemState state;

  int get missingQuantity =>
      (expectedQuantity - observedQuantity).clamp(0, expectedQuantity).toInt();

  bool get isMissing => state == AtlasShelfExpectedItemState.missingFromShelf;

  bool get isPartiallyObserved =>
      state == AtlasShelfExpectedItemState.partiallyObserved;
}

import '../../completion/models/atlas_completion_item.dart';
import '../../../services/duplicate_review_service.dart';
import 'atlas_shelf_expected_item.dart';
import 'atlas_shelf_observation.dart';
import 'atlas_shelf_proposed_action.dart';

final class AtlasShelfReconciliationResult {
  AtlasShelfReconciliationResult({
    required Iterable<AtlasShelfObservation> observations,
    required Iterable<AtlasShelfExpectedItem> expectedItems,
    required Iterable<AtlasShelfProposedAction> proposedActions,
    required Iterable<AtlasCompletionItem> completionGaps,
    required this.vaultIdentityReview,
  }) : observations = List<AtlasShelfObservation>.unmodifiable(observations),
       expectedItems = List<AtlasShelfExpectedItem>.unmodifiable(expectedItems),
       proposedActions = List<AtlasShelfProposedAction>.unmodifiable(
         proposedActions,
       ),
       completionGaps = List<AtlasCompletionItem>.unmodifiable(completionGaps);

  final List<AtlasShelfObservation> observations;
  final List<AtlasShelfExpectedItem> expectedItems;
  final List<AtlasShelfProposedAction> proposedActions;

  /// Catalog/set releases not yet owned. These are completion gaps, not
  /// physical objects that Atlas expected to see on the shelf.
  final List<AtlasCompletionItem> completionGaps;

  /// Existing Vault identity intelligence. Shelf Intelligence does not create
  /// another duplicate classifier.
  final DuplicateReviewReport vaultIdentityReview;

  int get ownedObservationCount => observations
      .where((item) => item.state == AtlasShelfObservationState.owned)
      .length;

  int get notInVaultCount => observations
      .where((item) => item.state == AtlasShelfObservationState.notInVault)
      .length;

  int get possibleVariantCount => observations
      .where((item) => item.state == AtlasShelfObservationState.possibleVariant)
      .length;

  int get extraCopyCount => observations
      .where((item) => item.state == AtlasShelfObservationState.extraCopy)
      .length;

  int get needsReviewCount => observations
      .where((item) => item.state == AtlasShelfObservationState.needsReview)
      .length;

  int get missingFromShelfCount => expectedItems
      .where((item) => item.missingQuantity > 0)
      .fold<int>(0, (total, item) => total + item.missingQuantity);

  bool get hasProposedActions => proposedActions.isNotEmpty;
}

import '../../../models/pop.dart';
import '../../../services/duplicate_review_service.dart';
import '../../collection/engine/atlas_collector_state_engine.dart';
import '../../collection/models/atlas_collector_state.dart';
import '../../completion/models/atlas_completion_result.dart';
import '../models/atlas_shelf_expected_item.dart';
import '../models/atlas_shelf_observation.dart';
import '../models/atlas_shelf_proposed_action.dart';
import '../models/atlas_shelf_reconciliation_result.dart';

/// Projects existing Atlas collector, identity-review, and completion truth
/// into a physical shelf-session view.
///
/// This engine is pure: it never writes to AppState and never commits actions.
final class AtlasShelfReconciliationEngine {
  const AtlasShelfReconciliationEngine({
    this.collectorStateEngine = const AtlasCollectorStateEngine(),
    this.duplicateReviewService = const DuplicateReviewService(),
  });

  final AtlasCollectorStateEngine collectorStateEngine;
  final DuplicateReviewService duplicateReviewService;

  AtlasShelfReconciliationResult reconcile({
    required Iterable<AtlasShelfObservation> observations,
    required List<Pop> collectionPops,
    Set<String> ownedWishlistIdentityKeys = const <String>{},
    AtlasCompletionResult? completionResult,
  }) {
    final List<AtlasShelfObservation> ordered = observations.toList()
      ..sort((first, second) {
        final int time = first.firstSeenAt.compareTo(second.firstSeenAt);
        if (time != 0) return time;
        return first.observationId.compareTo(second.observationId);
      });

    final Map<String, int> observedExactCounts = <String, int>{};
    final List<AtlasShelfObservation> reconciled = <AtlasShelfObservation>[];

    for (final AtlasShelfObservation observation in ordered) {
      reconciled.add(
        _reconcileObservation(
          observation: observation,
          collectionPops: collectionPops,
          ownedWishlistIdentityKeys: ownedWishlistIdentityKeys,
          observedExactCounts: observedExactCounts,
        ),
      );
    }

    final List<AtlasShelfExpectedItem> expectedItems = _buildExpectedItems(
      collectionPops: collectionPops,
      observations: reconciled,
    );

    final List<AtlasShelfProposedAction> actions = reconciled
        .map(_actionForObservation)
        .whereType<AtlasShelfProposedAction>()
        .toList(growable: false);

    return AtlasShelfReconciliationResult(
      observations: reconciled,
      expectedItems: expectedItems,
      proposedActions: actions,
      completionGaps: completionResult?.missingItems ?? const [],
      vaultIdentityReview: duplicateReviewService.buildReport(collectionPops),
    );
  }

  AtlasShelfObservation _reconcileObservation({
    required AtlasShelfObservation observation,
    required List<Pop> collectionPops,
    required Set<String> ownedWishlistIdentityKeys,
    required Map<String, int> observedExactCounts,
  }) {
    final Pop? product = observation.product;

    if (product == null ||
        observation.resolutionRequiresReview ||
        product.collectibleIdentityKey.trim().isEmpty) {
      return observation.copyWith(
        state: AtlasShelfObservationState.needsReview,
        ownedQuantity: 0,
        observedCopyIndex: 0,
      );
    }

    final bool hasPossibleVariantRelationship = _hasPossibleVariantRelationship(
      product: product,
      collectionPops: collectionPops,
    );

    final AtlasCollectorState collectorState = collectorStateEngine.evaluate(
      product: product,
      collectionPops: collectionPops,
      scannedBarcode: observation.scannedBarcode,
      ownedWishlistIdentityKeys: ownedWishlistIdentityKeys,
    );

    final String identityKey = product.collectibleIdentityKey.trim();
    final int copyIndex = (observedExactCounts[identityKey] ?? 0) + 1;
    observedExactCounts[identityKey] = copyIndex;

    // Identity Intelligence gets first say on meaningful release differences.
    // This prevents a reused UPC from collapsing Common/Chase/sticker variants
    // into an exact shelf match.
    if (hasPossibleVariantRelationship) {
      return observation.copyWith(
        state: AtlasShelfObservationState.possibleVariant,
        ownedQuantity: 0,
        observedCopyIndex: copyIndex,
      );
    }

    if (collectorState.isOwned) {
      final AtlasShelfObservationState state =
          copyIndex > collectorState.ownedQuantity
          ? AtlasShelfObservationState.extraCopy
          : AtlasShelfObservationState.owned;

      return observation.copyWith(
        state: state,
        ownedQuantity: collectorState.ownedQuantity,
        observedCopyIndex: copyIndex,
      );
    }

    if (collectorState.hasRelatedMatches) {
      return observation.copyWith(
        state: AtlasShelfObservationState.possibleVariant,
        ownedQuantity: 0,
        observedCopyIndex: copyIndex,
      );
    }

    return observation.copyWith(
      state: AtlasShelfObservationState.notInVault,
      ownedQuantity: 0,
      observedCopyIndex: copyIndex,
    );
  }

  bool _hasPossibleVariantRelationship({
    required Pop product,
    required List<Pop> collectionPops,
  }) {
    if (collectionPops.isEmpty) return false;

    final List<Pop> combined = <Pop>[...collectionPops, product];
    final DuplicateReviewReport report = duplicateReviewService.buildReport(
      combined,
    );

    return report.possibleVariantGroups.any(
      (group) => group.pops.any((pop) => identical(pop, product)),
    );
  }

  List<AtlasShelfExpectedItem> _buildExpectedItems({
    required List<Pop> collectionPops,
    required List<AtlasShelfObservation> observations,
  }) {
    final Map<String, int> observedByIdentity = <String, int>{};

    for (final AtlasShelfObservation observation in observations) {
      if (observation.state != AtlasShelfObservationState.owned &&
          observation.state != AtlasShelfObservationState.extraCopy) {
        continue;
      }

      final String key = observation.collectibleIdentityKey;
      if (key.isEmpty) continue;
      observedByIdentity[key] = (observedByIdentity[key] ?? 0) + 1;
    }

    final Map<String, ({Pop pop, int quantity})> expectedByIdentity =
        <String, ({Pop pop, int quantity})>{};

    for (final Pop pop in collectionPops.where((pop) => !pop.isWishlist)) {
      final String key = pop.collectibleIdentityKey.trim();
      if (key.isEmpty) continue;

      final int quantity = pop.quantity < 1 ? 1 : pop.quantity;
      final current = expectedByIdentity[key];
      expectedByIdentity[key] = (
        pop: current?.pop ?? pop,
        quantity: (current?.quantity ?? 0) + quantity,
      );
    }

    final List<AtlasShelfExpectedItem> result = <AtlasShelfExpectedItem>[];

    for (final entry in expectedByIdentity.entries) {
      final int expectedQuantity = entry.value.quantity;
      final int observedQuantity = (observedByIdentity[entry.key] ?? 0)
          .clamp(0, expectedQuantity)
          .toInt();

      final AtlasShelfExpectedItemState state;
      if (observedQuantity <= 0) {
        state = AtlasShelfExpectedItemState.missingFromShelf;
      } else if (observedQuantity < expectedQuantity) {
        state = AtlasShelfExpectedItemState.partiallyObserved;
      } else {
        state = AtlasShelfExpectedItemState.observed;
      }

      result.add(
        AtlasShelfExpectedItem(
          pop: entry.value.pop,
          expectedQuantity: expectedQuantity,
          observedQuantity: observedQuantity,
          state: state,
        ),
      );
    }

    return List<AtlasShelfExpectedItem>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  AtlasShelfProposedAction? _actionForObservation(
    AtlasShelfObservation observation,
  ) {
    final String id = observation.observationId;

    return switch (observation.state) {
      AtlasShelfObservationState.owned => null,
      AtlasShelfObservationState.notInVault => AtlasShelfProposedAction(
        actionId: 'shelf-add-$id',
        type: AtlasShelfProposedActionType.addToVault,
        observationId: id,
        title: 'Add to Vault',
        explanation:
            'This observed release is not currently owned in the scoped Vault.',
      ),
      AtlasShelfObservationState.possibleVariant => AtlasShelfProposedAction(
        actionId: 'shelf-variant-$id',
        type: AtlasShelfProposedActionType.reviewVariant,
        observationId: id,
        title: 'Review Variant / Sticker',
        explanation:
            'Atlas found a related release, but not an exact owned release.',
      ),
      AtlasShelfObservationState.extraCopy => AtlasShelfProposedAction(
        actionId: 'shelf-copy-$id',
        type: AtlasShelfProposedActionType.addAnotherCopy,
        observationId: id,
        title: 'Review Extra Copy',
        explanation:
            'More physical copies were observed than the scoped Vault quantity.',
      ),
      AtlasShelfObservationState.needsReview => AtlasShelfProposedAction(
        actionId: 'shelf-review-$id',
        type: AtlasShelfProposedActionType.reviewObservation,
        observationId: id,
        title: 'Needs Review',
        explanation:
            'Identity evidence is incomplete or the scanner requested collector review.',
      ),
    };
  }
}

import '../../models/pop.dart';
import '../catalog/converters/atlas_catalog_converter.dart';
import '../completion/models/atlas_completion_result.dart';
import '../scan/continuous/models/atlas_perception_frame_result.dart';
import '../scan/results/atlas_continuous_scan_result.dart';
import '../scan/tracking/atlas_scan_observation.dart';
import 'engine/atlas_shelf_reconciliation_engine.dart';
import 'models/atlas_shelf_observation.dart';
import 'models/atlas_shelf_scan_session.dart';

final class AtlasShelfSessionConfig {
  const AtlasShelfSessionConfig({
    this.reidentificationWindow = const Duration(seconds: 8),
    this.enableConservativeReidentification = true,
  });

  final Duration reidentificationWindow;

  /// Reassociation is intentionally conservative: exact release identity,
  /// inactive prior observation, within the time window, and exactly one
  /// eligible prior object. Ambiguous same-release copies are never merged.
  final bool enableConservativeReidentification;
}

/// Owns transient Room/Shelf scan-session state.
///
/// This coordinator has no AppState dependency and exposes no Vault mutation
/// methods. Reconciliation produces staged actions only.
final class AtlasShelfSessionCoordinator {
  AtlasShelfSessionCoordinator({
    required String sessionId,
    required String collectionName,
    DateTime? startedAt,
    AtlasShelfReconciliationEngine? reconciliationEngine,
    this.config = const AtlasShelfSessionConfig(),
  }) : reconciliationEngine =
           reconciliationEngine ?? const AtlasShelfReconciliationEngine(),
       _session = AtlasShelfScanSession(
         sessionId: sessionId,
         collectionName: collectionName,
         startedAt: (startedAt ?? DateTime.now()).toUtc(),
         lastUpdatedAt: (startedAt ?? DateTime.now()).toUtc(),
       ) {
    if (sessionId.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(sessionId, 'sessionId', 'cannot be empty');
    }
    if (collectionName.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        collectionName,
        'collectionName',
        'cannot be empty',
      );
    }
    if (config.reidentificationWindow.isNegative) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        config.reidentificationWindow,
        'reidentificationWindow',
        'cannot be negative',
      );
    }
  }

  final AtlasShelfReconciliationEngine reconciliationEngine;
  final AtlasShelfSessionConfig config;

  AtlasShelfScanSession _session;
  int _nextObservationSequence = 1;

  AtlasShelfScanSession get session => _session;

  AtlasShelfObservation observeResolved({
    required String trackId,
    required Pop? product,
    required DateTime observedAt,
    bool requiresUserReview = false,
    String scannedBarcode = '',
    double confidence = 1,
    AtlasNormalizedBounds? bounds,
  }) {
    final String normalizedTrackId = trackId.trim();
    if (normalizedTrackId.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(trackId, 'trackId', 'cannot be empty');
    }
    if (!confidence.isFinite || confidence < 0 || confidence > 1) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        confidence,
        'confidence',
        'must be between 0 and 1',
      );
    }

    final DateTime timestamp = observedAt.toUtc();
    final List<AtlasShelfObservation> observations =
        List<AtlasShelfObservation>.from(_session.observations);

    final int existingTrackIndex = observations.indexWhere(
      (observation) => observation.sourceTrackIds.contains(normalizedTrackId),
    );

    if (existingTrackIndex >= 0) {
      final AtlasShelfObservation updated = observations[existingTrackIndex]
          .copyWith(
            lastSeenAt: timestamp,
            activeTrackId: normalizedTrackId,
            product: product,
            scannedBarcode: scannedBarcode,
            confidence: confidence,
            resolutionRequiresReview: requiresUserReview,
            lastKnownBounds: bounds,
          );
      observations[existingTrackIndex] = updated;
      _replaceObservations(observations, timestamp);
      return updated;
    }

    final AtlasShelfObservation? reidentified = _findReidentificationCandidate(
      observations: observations,
      product: product,
      observedAt: timestamp,
    );

    if (reidentified != null) {
      final int index = observations.indexWhere(
        (observation) =>
            observation.observationId == reidentified.observationId,
      );
      final Set<String> trackIds = <String>{
        ...reidentified.sourceTrackIds,
        normalizedTrackId,
      };
      final AtlasShelfObservation updated = reidentified.copyWith(
        lastSeenAt: timestamp,
        sourceTrackIds: trackIds,
        activeTrackId: normalizedTrackId,
        product: product,
        scannedBarcode: scannedBarcode,
        confidence: confidence,
        resolutionRequiresReview: requiresUserReview,
        lastKnownBounds: bounds,
        reidentificationConfidence: 0.85,
        notes: <String>[
          ...reidentified.notes,
          'Reassociated after track expiry using exact release identity.',
        ],
      );
      observations[index] = updated;
      _replaceObservations(observations, timestamp);
      return updated;
    }

    final AtlasShelfObservation created = AtlasShelfObservation(
      observationId: _createObservationId(),
      firstSeenAt: timestamp,
      lastSeenAt: timestamp,
      sourceTrackIds: <String>{normalizedTrackId},
      activeTrackId: normalizedTrackId,
      product: product,
      scannedBarcode: scannedBarcode,
      confidence: confidence,
      resolutionRequiresReview: requiresUserReview,
      lastKnownBounds: bounds,
    );
    observations.add(created);
    _replaceObservations(observations, timestamp);
    return created;
  }

  AtlasShelfObservation? ingestContinuousResult(
    AtlasContinuousScanResult result, {
    AtlasNormalizedBounds? bounds,
  }) {
    final catalogProduct = result.resolvedCatalogProduct;
    final Pop? product = catalogProduct == null
        ? null
        : AtlasCatalogConverter.toPop(
            catalogProduct,
            owner: 'Atlas Shelf',
            quantity: 1,
            timestamp: result.completedAt,
          );

    final String scannedBarcode =
        result.session.bestCandidate?.normalizedValue.trim() ?? '';

    return observeResolved(
      trackId: result.trackId,
      product: product,
      observedAt: result.completedAt,
      requiresUserReview: result.requiresUserReview,
      scannedBarcode: scannedBarcode,
      confidence: result.session.confidence.clamp(0, 1).toDouble(),
      bounds: bounds,
    );
  }

  void applyPerceptionFrame(AtlasPerceptionFrameResult frame) {
    final List<AtlasShelfObservation> observations =
        List<AtlasShelfObservation>.from(_session.observations);
    bool changed = false;

    for (var index = 0; index < observations.length; index++) {
      AtlasShelfObservation observation = observations[index];
      final String? activeTrackId = observation.activeTrackId;

      if (activeTrackId != null &&
          frame.expiredTrackIds.contains(activeTrackId)) {
        observation = observation.copyWith(
          lastSeenAt: frame.timestamp,
          clearActiveTrackId: true,
        );
        changed = true;
      }

      if (activeTrackId != null) {
        for (final candidate in frame.candidates) {
          if (candidate.trackId == activeTrackId &&
              candidate.normalizedBounds != null) {
            observation = observation.copyWith(
              lastSeenAt: candidate.lastSeenAt,
              lastKnownBounds: candidate.normalizedBounds,
            );
            changed = true;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      observations[index] = observation;
    }

    if (changed) {
      _replaceObservations(observations, frame.timestamp.toUtc());
    }
  }

  AtlasShelfScanSession reconcile({
    required List<Pop> collectionPops,
    Set<String> ownedWishlistIdentityKeys = const <String>{},
    AtlasCompletionResult? completionResult,
    DateTime? at,
  }) {
    final result = reconciliationEngine.reconcile(
      observations: _session.observations,
      collectionPops: collectionPops,
      ownedWishlistIdentityKeys: ownedWishlistIdentityKeys,
      completionResult: completionResult,
    );

    _session = _session.copyWith(
      lastUpdatedAt: (at ?? DateTime.now()).toUtc(),
      status: AtlasShelfScanSessionStatus.reviewReady,
      observations: result.observations,
      reconciliation: result,
    );
    return _session;
  }

  AtlasShelfScanSession markCompleted({DateTime? at}) {
    _session = _session.copyWith(
      lastUpdatedAt: (at ?? DateTime.now()).toUtc(),
      status: AtlasShelfScanSessionStatus.completed,
    );
    return _session;
  }

  AtlasShelfObservation? _findReidentificationCandidate({
    required List<AtlasShelfObservation> observations,
    required Pop? product,
    required DateTime observedAt,
  }) {
    if (!config.enableConservativeReidentification || product == null) {
      return null;
    }

    final String identityKey = product.collectibleIdentityKey.trim();
    if (identityKey.isEmpty) return null;

    final List<AtlasShelfObservation> candidates = observations
        .where((item) {
          if (item.isActive || item.collectibleIdentityKey != identityKey) {
            return false;
          }
          final Duration elapsed = observedAt.difference(item.lastSeenAt);
          return !elapsed.isNegative &&
              elapsed <= config.reidentificationWindow;
        })
        .toList(growable: false);

    // More than one identical inactive copy is physically ambiguous. Do not
    // guess which copy returned to frame.
    return candidates.length == 1 ? candidates.single : null;
  }

  void _replaceObservations(
    List<AtlasShelfObservation> observations,
    DateTime updatedAt,
  ) {
    _session = _session.copyWith(
      lastUpdatedAt: updatedAt.toUtc(),
      observations: observations,
      clearReconciliation: true,
      status: AtlasShelfScanSessionStatus.scanning,
    );
  }

  String _createObservationId() {
    final int sequence = _nextObservationSequence++;
    return 'shelf_${_session.sessionId}_$sequence';
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import '../acquisition/atlas_evidence_accumulator.dart';
import '../models/scan_code.dart';
import '../tracking/atlas_object_track.dart';
import '../tracking/atlas_object_tracker.dart';
import '../tracking/atlas_scan_observation.dart';
import 'atlas_continuous_candidate_projector.dart';
import 'atlas_frame_triage_gate.dart';
import 'models/atlas_continuous_candidate.dart';
import 'models/atlas_frame_quality_assessment.dart';
import 'models/atlas_perception_frame_result.dart';

typedef AtlasStableCandidateSubmitter =
    bool Function({required String trackId, required ScanCode stableCode});

final class AtlasContinuousPerceptionConfig {
  const AtlasContinuousPerceptionConfig({
    this.minimumFrameInterval = const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
  });

  /// Default 250 ms cadence targets approximately 4 FPS, inside the 3-5 FPS
  /// continuous-perception budget. Callers may tune this without changing the
  /// tracking or evidence contracts.
  final Duration minimumFrameInterval;
}

/// Shared 6A foundation for camera Shelf Scan and future live-feed ingestion.
///
/// Responsibilities:
/// - sample cadence enforcement
/// - frame-quality fast-fail
/// - reuse AtlasObjectTracker for spatial persistence
/// - reuse AtlasEvidenceAccumulator for stable barcode agreement
/// - emit transient candidate/result models for HUD consumers
/// - optionally cross the existing Scanner 4 submission boundary
///
/// This coordinator never mutates the Vault and never rewrites product identity.
final class AtlasContinuousPerceptionCoordinator {
  AtlasContinuousPerceptionCoordinator({
    AtlasObjectTracker? objectTracker,
    AtlasEvidenceAccumulator? evidenceAccumulator,
    AtlasFrameTriageGate? frameTriageGate,
    this.submitStableCandidate,
    this.config = const AtlasContinuousPerceptionConfig(),
  }) : objectTracker = objectTracker ?? AtlasObjectTracker(),
       evidenceAccumulator = evidenceAccumulator ?? AtlasEvidenceAccumulator(),
       frameTriageGate = frameTriageGate ?? AtlasFrameTriageGate() {
    if (config.minimumFrameInterval.isNegative) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        config.minimumFrameInterval,
        'minimumFrameInterval',
        'minimumFrameInterval cannot be negative.',
      );
    }
  }

  final AtlasObjectTracker objectTracker;
  final AtlasEvidenceAccumulator evidenceAccumulator;
  final AtlasFrameTriageGate frameTriageGate;
  final AtlasStableCandidateSubmitter? submitStableCandidate;
  final AtlasContinuousPerceptionConfig config;

  final StreamController<AtlasPerceptionFrameResult> _resultsController =
      StreamController<AtlasPerceptionFrameResult>.broadcast(sync: true);

  final Set<String> _knownTrackIds = <String>{};
  final Set<String> _submittedTrackIds = <String>{};

  DateTime? _lastInputAt;
  DateTime? _lastProcessedAt;
  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult? _latestResult;
  bool _isDisposed = false;

  Stream<AtlasPerceptionFrameResult> get results => _resultsController.stream;

  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult? get latestResult => _latestResult;

  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult processFrame({
    required DateTime timestamp,
    required List<AtlasScanObservation> observations,
    AtlasFrameQualitySample? qualitySample,
  }) {
    if (_isDisposed) {
      throw StateError('AtlasContinuousPerceptionCoordinator is disposed.');
    }

    final DateTime normalizedTimestamp = timestamp.toUtc();
    final DateTime? previousInput = _lastInputAt;
    if (previousInput != null && normalizedTimestamp.isBefore(previousInput)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        timestamp,
        'timestamp',
        'Frame timestamps must be monotonic.',
      );
    }
    _lastInputAt = normalizedTimestamp;

    final AtlasFrameQualityAssessment qualityAssessment = frameTriageGate
        .evaluate(qualitySample ?? AtlasFrameQualitySample());

    final DateTime? previousProcessed = _lastProcessedAt;
    if (previousProcessed != null &&
        normalizedTimestamp.difference(previousProcessed) <
            config.minimumFrameInterval) {
      return _emit(
        AtlasPerceptionFrameResult(
          timestamp: normalizedTimestamp,
          disposition: AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.skippedCadence,
          qualityAssessment: qualityAssessment,
          candidates: _projectCurrentCandidates(),
        ),
      );
    }

    _lastProcessedAt = normalizedTimestamp;

    final List<AtlasObjectTrack> tracked = objectTracker.processFrame(
      observations: qualityAssessment.isAccepted
          ? observations
          : const <AtlasScanObservation>[],
      timestamp: normalizedTimestamp,
    );

    final Set<String> currentTrackIds = tracked
        .map((AtlasObjectTrack track) => track.trackId)
        .toSet();
    final Set<String> expiredTrackIds = _knownTrackIds.difference(
      currentTrackIds,
    );
    _knownTrackIds
      ..clear()
      ..addAll(currentTrackIds);

    final Set<String> submittedThisFrame = <String>{};

    if (qualityAssessment.isAccepted && submitStableCandidate != null) {
      for (final AtlasObjectTrack track in tracked) {
        if (track.isCooldown || _submittedTrackIds.contains(track.trackId)) {
          continue;
        }

        final AtlasAccumulatedEvidence? evidence = evidenceAccumulator
            .evaluateTrack(track);
        if (evidence == null || !evidence.isReadyForResolution) {
          continue;
        }

        final bool accepted = submitStableCandidate!(
          trackId: track.trackId,
          stableCode: evidence.stableCode,
        );

        if (accepted) {
          _submittedTrackIds.add(track.trackId);
          submittedThisFrame.add(track.trackId);
          objectTracker.markCooldown(
            trackId: track.trackId,
            startedAt: normalizedTimestamp,
          );
        }
      }
    }

    final AtlasPerceptionFrameResult result = AtlasPerceptionFrameResult(
      timestamp: normalizedTimestamp,
      disposition: qualityAssessment.isAccepted
          ? AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.processed
          : AtlasPerceptionFrameDisposition.rejectedQuality,
      qualityAssessment: qualityAssessment,
      candidates: _projectCurrentCandidates(),
      expiredTrackIds: expiredTrackIds,
      submittedTrackIds: submittedThisFrame,
    );

    return _emit(result);
  }

  void reset() {
    if (_isDisposed) return;
    objectTracker.reset();
    _knownTrackIds.clear();
    _submittedTrackIds.clear();
    _lastInputAt = null;
    _lastProcessedAt = null;
    _latestResult = null;
  }

  Future<void> dispose() async {
    if (_isDisposed) return;
    _isDisposed = true;
    await _resultsController.close();
  }

  List<AtlasContinuousCandidate> _projectCurrentCandidates() {
    return objectTracker.tracks
        .map((AtlasObjectTrack track) {
          final AtlasAccumulatedEvidence? evidence = evidenceAccumulator
              .evaluateTrack(track);
          return AtlasContinuousCandidateProjector.project(
            track: track,
            accumulatedEvidence: evidence,
          );
        })
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  AtlasPerceptionFrameResult _emit(AtlasPerceptionFrameResult result) {
    _latestResult = result;
    _resultsController.add(result);
    return result;
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import '../../catalog/models/atlas_catalog_product.dart';
import '../../catalog/services/atlas_barcode_catalog_resolver.dart';
import '../engine/barcode_intelligence_engine.dart';
import '../engine/engine_context.dart';
import '../ledger/atlas_scan_ledger.dart';
import '../ledger/atlas_scan_ledger_entry.dart';
import '../models/scan_code.dart';
import '../models/scan_session.dart';
import '../models/scanner_type.dart';
import '../pipeline/standard_scan_pipeline.dart';
import '../queue/atlas_resolution_job.dart';
